strat: H first / M1-R1 NW / M2-R2 NE; lines T-M-R-H

steps.title: Stack under the first tower
steps.rule: Everyone stacks under the first tower as it appears.

steps.title: Healers take the first tower, tanks bait the first wing
steps.cue: Wings Dark and Light cast starts
steps.rule: Healers soak the first tower. M1 and R wait just west of it, M2 and C just east of it.

MainTank.rule: Take the first wing cleave from the tower spot on the side of the wing that glows first.

OffTank.rule: Bait the first wing buster: hug Pandora when it is dark (nearest), run as far as you can when it is light (farthest).

steps.title: Tanks swap, melee and ranged take the next towers
steps.rule: M1 and R soak the west tower, M2 and C the east one, whichever comes first; healers wait north of Pandora.

MainTank.rule: Bait the second wing buster: tight on Pandora for dark, far north for light.

OffTank.rule: Take the second wing cleave from the tower spot on that wing's side.

steps.title: Line up for Polarizing Strikes
steps.rule: Polarizing Strikes: each round a light and a dark line stack go to the closest player on each side of Pandora. West group MT, RH, M1, R; east group OT, SH, M2, C. Stand 6m out on your group's south diagonal.

MainTank.rule: Pick Pandora up just north of her and face her north before her cast locks her facing.

OffTank.rule: Stand with MT just north of Pandora, then take your group's first line.

steps.title: First line baits step up
steps.rule: Polarizing Strikes: each round a light and a dark line stack go to the closest player on each side of Pandora. West group MT, RH, M1, R; east group OT, SH, M2, C. Tanks bait the first round 4m out on their group's diagonal; the rest stand 6m out right behind them.

steps.title: Next baits step up
steps.cue: the line hits and Light/Dark Resistance Down lands on its front bait
steps.rule: Rounds go tanks, then melee, then ranged, then healers: the next pair steps to 4m on its diagonal, everyone else 6m behind.

steps.title: Cross after each hit
steps.rule: Everyone who has taken a line crosses to the other group's diagonal, so the next colour they take is the other one; the next baits move up close to Pandora.
